neighbours.label: 'and' continuing after a negated clause ('isn't germane here, and neither…')
fire: The weather report wasn't reliable, and neither was the old map we carried.
This is no ordinary bakery, and that's because its owner trained in Lyon.
The plan did not work in practice, and nobody wanted to admit it.
These spots are not caused by sunburn and therefore need a different cream.
Her argument isn't relevant to the case, and the judge said so.
The bridge was never finished, and the river still has no crossing.
You do not simply delete the old file and you do not rename it either.
The museum isn't large, and yet it holds a remarkable collection.
quiet: The weather report was reliable, and so was the old map we carried.
This is a popular bakery, and its owner trained in Lyon.
The plan worked well in practice, and everybody was pleased.
These spots are caused by sunburn and need a soothing cream.
Her argument is relevant to the case, and the judge agreed.
The bridge was finished in May, and the river finally has a crossing.
You simply copy the old file and you rename it afterwards.
The museum is large, and it holds a remarkable collection.

notes: Card: ' and' x18; top contexts follow a negated clause (isn't germane, is no ... project, are not caused, do not just change). Near misses are the same sentences made positive.
